metadata.description: Jason Matthew's personal Claude Code skills marketplace.

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Turns an intent into a grounded, cited, build-ready ADR with load-bearing decisions surfaced to the human, then hands it to the subagent-driven-development loop. Front-end for adr → sdd.

plugins.name: claude-design
plugins.description: Write great prompts/specs for Claude Design (claude.ai/design): a paste-ready design brief on the official goal/layout/content/audience framework, plus the Claude Code driving path (/design, /design-sync, the Claude Design MCP server, and the build handoff).

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary and discipline for designing deep modules — a lot of behaviour behind a small interface at a clean seam, testable through that interface. Glossary, the deletion test, seam discipline, and model-tiered design-it-twice. Adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Cross-provider adversarial plan/design-doc review via OpenAI Codex (GPT-5.6 Terra): verdict-loop protocol, atomic chain guard, cross-repo decision-gate log.

plugins.name: deep-dive
plugins.description: Model-tiered, adversarially-verified multi-source research via parallel sub-agents and synthesis with citations. Cheaper alternative to the built-in all-Opus deep-research.

plugins.name: design-gate-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse Bash gate for the brainstorming HARD-GATE — asks the user before a new-project scaffold command (npm create vite, create-next-app, cargo new, rails new, django-admin startproject, …) so the model can't jump to implementation before a design is approved. Stateless and fail-open; add design-gate:ack to the command to proceed after approval.

plugins.name: docs-sync-guard
plugins.description: Two mechanisms against docs drift. A blocking PreToolUse git-commit gate denies a commit that changes code without staging its covering docs — per-plugin README/CLAUDE.md pairs in plugins/ monorepos, and a generic nearest-covering-doc rule (README.md/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md walking up from each changed file) in any repo; tests, version bumps, markdown and lockfiles never trigger it, and docs-sync:ack bypasses deliberately. Separately, a never-blocking consolidation trigger counts commits since the .docs-sync record and nudges in-session toward /docs-consolidate, an audit for contradictions, stale claims, orphans and bloat.

plugins.name: domain-modeling
plugins.description: Actively build and sharpen a project's ubiquitous language — an opinionated CONTEXT.md glossary — by challenging terms, disambiguating overloaded words, and stress-testing domain relationships. Cross-references adr for decision records. Adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend/UI design guidance, gated by scope: a light or surgical change gets inline principles; a wide-sweeping or highly-detailed design gets routed to Claude Design in the browser with a paste-ready design brief.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Context-fill-triggered handoff skill — writes a structured resume doc when context fills, auto-loads it on next session.

plugins.name: session-retro
plugins.description: Interactive session retrospectives — deterministic Stop/PreCompact triggers, batch-scoped diff- and event-log-driven interview, native memory entries. No external services.

plugins.name: ship-gate
plugins.description: Stop-hook gate against trail-off: detects unpushed commits at turn end and injects an agent-directed nudge to review and finish the branch.

plugins.name: subagent-driven-development
plugins.description: Deterministic workflow-driven subagent development loop — plan/confirm in the controller, then a background Workflow enforces per-task implement/review/fix with tiered models and codified ponytail discipline.

plugins.name: superpowers-core
plugins.description: Owned fork of the superpowers process skills (brainstorming, systematic-debugging, writing-plans, writing-skills, test-driven-development) plus the using-skills dispatcher.

plugins.name: workflow-model-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hooks that keep sub-model choices deliberate — denies high-fan-out Workflow scripts with no per-agent model: override, asks before all-Opus built-in named workflows (e.g. deep-research), and denies ad-hoc Agent dispatches that omit model unless the agent type pins one in frontmatter.

plugins.name: writing-artifacts
plugins.description: Positive writing system for durable written artifacts (READMEs, ADRs, PR descriptions, docs, runbooks): reader-expectation prose, Diátaxis document jobs, plain-language structure. Complements reply-style rules in global CLAUDE.md.
